title: User Interface Elements
definition: The visual and interactive components of the CADMIES knowledge system that enable users to interact with the system and perform operations.

difficulty_levels.beginner: User interface elements are the buttons, menus, and screens you see on a computer. They let you tell the computer what to do and show you the results.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: User interface elements are the visual and interactive components that enable users to interact with the CADMIES system. They include elements such as buttons, search bars, and data tables, and they provide a means for users to navigate the system and perform operations.
difficulty_levels.expert: The design of user interface elements in the CADMIES system is guided by principles of user-centered design. This ensures that the system is easy to learn and use, and that it meets the needs and expectations of its users. The user interface elements are also designed to be consistent and cohesive, providing a unified and polished user experience.

extra_fields.insight: The user interface elements in the CADMIES system are designed to be intuitive, consistent, and cohesive, providing a unified and polished user experience that meets the needs and expectations of its users.
